text:
alex: opened PR to tidy the hello quickstart + onboarding: SDK8 async, remove .rw_token, clarify Docker port, and add a tiny ephemeral-key example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302
maya: Thanks. Can you call out the exact snippet diffs in the PR description so reviewers can focus?
alex: done: python sync->async, node top-level await + CJS fallback, replace sed -i with cross-platform node/python one-liners, curl header canonicalized to Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>, Docker EXPOSE -> 8080.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #1302: building site, running linkcheck and snippet-tests.
toni: quick note: one curl snippet still used lowercase header. will fix.
yuki: snippet-tests on macOS often fail with sed -i — include both Node and Python options and label them.
alex: replaced sed with two one-liners and added small comment about requiring node/python. pushed.
ci-bot: snippet-tests failed on macos runner: entrypoint.sh used unguarded var (shellcheck). log: https://ci.internal/1302/snippet-log.
maya: fix with if [ -n "${RW_API_KEY:-}" ] guard. also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ (missing header vs expired key).
alex: patched script, added FAQ and a one-line KMS pointer for rotation. re-run CI.
ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #1302. Mergeable.
yuki: I'll sanity-check staging once deployed.
ci-bot: Site deploy to staging started.
yuki: Verified staging: quickstart runs locally, Docker note clear, ephemeral example works. tiny wording tweak on the ephemeral TTL that I pushed to the staging branch.
maya: LGTM from docs UX. merging after final CI green. thanks everyone :tada:
